ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (lobes) to low-intensity black pixels (borders and base).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white segments occupy the central 80% of both lobes. High-contrast black pigmentation is localized at the trailing edge margin and forms a bifurcated, symmetrical dark region at the central hinge/peduncle interface. Tan-hued pixel mottling is visible across the lower-medial sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth is significant relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-amplitude serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring jagged peaks and deep valleys varying from 5 to 20 pixels in height relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature along the trailing edge, tapering to acute, pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular black pixel clusters located on the mid-lateral region of the right lobe; one larger irregular black cluster located in the mid-central region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, dark diagonal linear mark is visible on the upper-right lobe surface; multiple vertical linear disruptions are clustered near the peduncle base on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration along the trailing edge indicates past mechanical wear or predation interaction; widespread tan/brownish discoloration across the ventral surface suggesting diatom colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: The black pigmentation at the fluke base forms a sharp, symmetrical butterfly-like silhouette extending into the medial regions of both lobes.
